character_facts: Aghora is a warrior who fights with a sword and uses a two-handed thrust or cut.
Steelhead is heavily armored and remains unaffected by a seemingly lethal strike.
Steelhead is capable of speaking calmly during the fight, explaining the tactical disadvantage to Aghora.
continuity_links: This page depicts an ongoing father-daughter duel between Aghora and Steelhead rather than the start of the confrontation.
The narration marks a passage of time from two days of stalemate to dawn on the third day.
dialogue_meaning: The narration states that the duel remained evenly matched for two days.
The narration identifies Aghora as the attacker on the third day and says the target is her father.
An exclamation signals shock that the supposedly decisive blow had no effect.
The armored speaker says Aghora has entered an unwinnable contest because her metal body cannot be pierced by a sword.
locations: An unspecified combat arena or interior space filled with bright energy effects
lore_facts: Aghora and her father are engaged in a prolonged duel.
Aghora's father is identified on-page as Steelhead.
Steelhead can withstand a sword blow to the waist that should have bisected him.
Aghora has given herself a metal body.
Aghora's metal body is described on-page as invulnerable to sword strokes.
plot_events: Two armored combatants fight continuously for two days without either landing a decisive blow.
On the third day, Aghora penetrates her father's defenses with a two-handed strike aimed at his waist.
The strike that should have cut him in half does not disable him.
Steelhead continues fighting without even staggering from the impact.
The surviving fighter verbally explains that Aghora's metal body is invulnerable to sword strokes, framing the contest as unwinnable for her.
uncertainties: The page image is legible overall, but some text is small, so wording may not be exact.
The final speech balloon is attributed visually to the seated armored fighter, likely Steelhead, but the exact speaker tag is not explicitly labeled in the panel.
The specific setting is not identified on this page beyond a bright, enclosed-looking combat space.
visual_summary: A brightly lit duel between two armored warriors continues across multiple panels. They clash in midair and at close range with glowing energy and sword strikes. A narration box explains that they fought evenly for two days. On the third day, Aghora appears to break through her father's guard with a two-handed cut to his waist, but the larger armored opponent remains standing. In the final panel, the seated armored fighter declares that Aghora made a losing choice by giving herself a metal body that no sword can pierce.
